ngx_http_v3_module.notes: Downstream h3 over Quinn. TLS 1.3, Retry, independent admission and streaming. WebTransport and upstream HTTP/3 are separate.

ngx_http_v3_module.http3.notes: Dedicated QUIC UDP listener with TLS 1.3 and h3 ALPN.

ngx_http_v3_module.http3_max_concurrent_.notes: Per-connection QUIC receive stream limit and explicit request task admission.

ngx_http_v3_module.quic_retry.notes: QUIC address validation before admitting a handshake.

ngx_stream_core_module.notes: Independent IPv4/IPv6 TCP, UDP and TLS preread listeners. Stream syntax and lifecycle settings differ.

ngx_stream_core_module.listen.notes: Literal IP sockets, opt-in reuseport and inbound PROXY on TCP. Several NGINX socket options differ.

ngx_stream_core_module.preread_buffer_si.notes: Bounded rustls ClientHello parser and retained wire prefix.

ngx_stream_core_module.preread_timeout.notes: Absolute TLS preread deadline under the session deadline.

ngx_stream_core_module.proxy_protocol_ti.notes: Absolute header deadline on explicitly trusted stream TCP listeners.

ngx_stream_proxy_module.notes: Generic TCP and UDP socket relays. Stream TLS termination, rate directives and NGINX retry semantics remain open.

ngx_stream_proxy_module.proxy_pass.notes: Configured literal IP groups for TCP and UDP, with Unix endpoints for TCP. Variable destinations remain open.

ngx_stream_proxy_module.proxy_buffer_siz.notes: Two bounded configurable TCP buffers and bounded UDP datagrams.

ngx_stream_proxy_module.proxy_connect_ti.notes: Per-listener TCP connect and preamble deadline.

ngx_stream_proxy_module.proxy_half_close.notes: Directional FIN forwarding, enabled for TCP.

ngx_stream_proxy_module.proxy_protocol.notes: Outbound TCP v1 or v2, with optional trusted inbound TCP framing.

ngx_stream_proxy_module.proxy_timeout.notes: TCP forwarding progress and UDP session inactivity, plus absolute lifetime.

ngx_stream_proxy_module.proxy_socket_kee.notes: Configurable TCP keepalive time for TCP endpoints.

ngx_stream_realip_module.notes: Trusted PROXY source and destination metadata used separately from socket peer admission.

ngx_stream_realip_module.set_real_ip_fro.notes: Explicit socket peer CIDRs for inbound TCP PROXY.

ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module.notes: Routes by visible SNI and advertised ALPN without TLS termination.

ngx_stream_ssl_preread_module.ssl_prerea.notes: Bounded rustls ClientHello parsing across TLS records.

ngx_stream_upstream_module.notes: Weighted endpoints with per-transport passive cooldown and consistent IP-key hashing.

ngx_stream_upstream_module.server.notes: Literal TCP/UDP IP and TCP Unix endpoints with weights. Dynamic DNS and additional flags remain open.

ngx_stream_upstream_hash_module.hash.notes: Weighted rendezvous using the canonical client IP. NGINX key expressions and hashing ring differ.

ngx_http_realip_module.notes: Proxy-wide trusted IPv4 and IPv6 CIDRs with recursive forwarding and X-Real-IP.

ngx_http_realip_module.set_real_ip_from.notes: Literal trusted addresses and CIDRs. Hostnames, unix peers and NGINX context inheritance differ.

ngx_http_realip_module.real_ip_header.notes: Selects X-Forwarded-For or X-Real-IP. Arbitrary fields and PROXY protocol are unavailable.

ngx_http_realip_module.real_ip_recursive.notes: Right-to-left trusted chain resolution for X-Forwarded-For. Malformed or oversized chains fall back to the socket peer.

ngx_http_rewrite_module.notes: Bounded per-route actions with numbered Rust byte-regex captures.

ngx_http_rewrite_module.rewrite.notes: Internal reselection with query preservation or replacement. Nested, PCRE-only, contextual and flag semantics differ.

ngx_http_rewrite_module.return.notes: Origin-relative redirect statuses 301, 302, 303, 307 and 308. General body/status functions differ.

ngx_http_upstream_module.server.notes: Supported upstream weights and existing bounded pooling. NGINX parameter families remain partial.

ngx_http_upstream_ip_hash_module.ip_hash.notes: Full canonical client-address hashing with a stable local mapping. NGINX hash mapping differs.

ngx_http_upstream_hash_module.hash.notes: Weighted rendezvous hashing of canonical client addresses. NGINX key expressions and ring mapping differ.

ngx_http_upstream_random_module.random.notes: Power-of-two choice using active request load, with different sampling and weighting semantics.

ngx_http_access_module.notes: Final-route IPv4/IPv6 allowlist with implicit denial. Ordered allow/deny rules and inheritance differ.

ngx_http_access_module.allow.notes: Route-local CIDR allowlist with resolved client address.

ngx_http_access_module.deny.notes: Implicit denial outside a configured allowlist. Ordered deny rules differ.

ngx_http_limit_req_module.notes: Bounded in-process rate zones with burst and delay. Keys, inheritance and cross-process sharing differ.

ngx_http_limit_req_module.limit_req.notes: One named admission zone per route with configurable excess and delay.

ngx_http_limit_req_module.limit_req_zone.notes: Client-IP or route keys with bounded active state and no eviction of live debt.

ngx_http_limit_req_module.limit_req_stat.notes: Custom HTTP rejection status and body.

ngx_http_limit_conn_module.notes: Concurrent requests or streams per configured admission key and a separate physical peer socket cap.

ngx_http_limit_conn_module.limit_conn.notes: Configurable active request/stream cap per admission key.

ngx_http_limit_conn_module.limit_conn_zo.notes: Bounded per-key admission with cancellation-safe release.

ngx_http_limit_conn_module.limit_conn_st.notes: Custom HTTP status on route concurrency rejection. The physical peer cap closes the socket.

ngx_http_core_module.notes: Independent HTTP TCP and QUIC sockets with exact or edge-wildcard hosts, literal and segment-aware prefixes, exact paths and bounded flat regex locations.

ngx_http_core_module.listen.notes: Legacy or explicit cleartext/TLS TCP listeners with an independent QUIC UDP listener. Most NGINX socket options and per-server scoping differ.

ngx_http_core_module.server_name.notes: Exact names, complete leading and trailing wildcard labels, longest wildcard precedence and significant port. Default servers, shorthand names and regex are unavailable.

ngx_http_core_module.location.notes: Verified flat exact, plain prefix, ^~, ~ and ~* precedence for the shared raw-path subset. Existing segment-aware matching remains the default. Named locations and bounded internal redirects use the same authority declaration. Nested and PCRE-only rules and URI normalization differ.

ngx_http_core_module.client_max_body_siz.notes: Global byte limit applies to upload and download. Streaming bodies exceeding it can be interrupted after headers.

ngx_http_core_module.client_header_timeo.notes: Global header deadline with separate HTTP/2 framing semantics.

ngx_http_proxy_module.notes: Bounded streaming to configured upstreams only.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_pass.notes: Preserves the request URI. Variable destinations and URI substitution are unavailable.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_set_header.notes: Static route-local replacements and removals after hop filtering. Dynamic values, inherited rules and proxy-owned protocol edits are unavailable.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_hide_header.notes: Route-local removal of ordinary origin response headers. NGINX implicit defaults and inheritance differ.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_connect_time.notes: Global timeout applied to DNS and socket connect phases separately.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_buffering.notes: Streams responses with bounded protocol buffers. Configurable buffering and disk spooling are unavailable.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_request_buff.notes: Streams requests with bounded protocol buffers.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_ssl_verify.notes: Configured upstream TLS always verifies peer identity and chain.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_ssl_trusted_.notes: One explicit CA bundle per TLS-enabled upstream.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_ssl_certific.notes: One explicit client certificate chain per TLS-enabled upstream.
One explicit client private key per TLS-enabled upstream.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_ssl_protocol.notes: TLS 1.2 and 1.3 selection per TLS-enabled upstream.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_ssl_session_.notes: Enable or disable rustls session resumption per TLS-enabled upstream.

ngx_http_upstream_module.notes: Local round-robin, least-inflight and passive health state with bounded pooling.

ngx_http_upstream_module.upstream.notes: Routes refer to configured endpoint IDs.

ngx_http_upstream_keepalive_module.keepa.notes: Global and per-endpoint idle limits across runtime threads.

ngx_http_upstream_least_conn_module.leas.notes: Least in-flight requests, including multiplexed streams.

ngx_http_ssl_module.notes: Inbound TLS 1.2/1.3 via rustls with exact SNI certificates, a default certificate, and listener-wide client authentication.

ngx_http_ssl_module.ssl_certificate.notes: One configured PEM certificate chain per exact SNI name and a default chain.

ngx_http_ssl_module.ssl_certificate_key.notes: One PEM private key per configured certificate chain.

ngx_http_ssl_module.ssl_protocols.notes: TLS 1.2 and 1.3 selection at the data listener.

ngx_http_ssl_module.ssl_client_certifica.notes: One strict client trust bundle for the data listener.

ngx_http_ssl_module.ssl_verify_client.notes: Require a client certificate on the TLS listener when a client CA bundle is configured.

ngx_http_ssl_module.ssl_session_cache.notes: Enable or disable rustls session resumption. Cache sizing and external sharing differ.

ngx_http_v2_module.notes: HTTP/2 over TLS ALPN or prior-knowledge cleartext with bounded streams.

ngx_http_grpc_module.notes: Native HTTP/2 gRPC forwarding, deadlines and trailers.

ngx_http_grpc_module.grpc_pass.notes: gRPC is identified by content type and routed to configured HTTP/2 upstreams.

ngx_http_log_module.notes: Fixed-schema JSONL logs with a bounded asynchronous queue.

ngx_http_log_module.access_log.notes: Fixed-schema JSONL with rotation and drop metrics.

ngx_http_stub_status_module.notes: Loopback metrics endpoint with Cauce-specific counters.

ngx_event_core_module.worker_connections.notes: Separate process-wide client and upstream connection budgets.

ngx_http_static_module.notes: Descriptor-confined GET and HEAD, MIME metadata, weak ETags and bounded streaming.

ngx_http_core_module.root.notes: Route-local absolute document root with descriptor confinement and conservative symlink handling.

ngx_http_core_module.alias.notes: Route-local literal prefix replacement with a confined absolute directory.

ngx_http_core_module.etag.notes: Weak metadata ETags with conditional request support. NGINX strong validator format differs.

ngx_http_index_module.notes: Bounded literal index names within the selected directory.

ngx_http_index_module.index.notes: Literal filenames. Variables and location re-selection differ.

ngx_http_autoindex_module.notes: Bounded opt-in HTML directory listings. Formats and rendering differ.

ngx_http_autoindex_module.autoindex.notes: Bounded opt-in HTML listing with conservative hidden-file and symlink policy.

ngx_http_headers_filter_module.notes: Static response Cache-Control and Expires plus existing header policy.

ngx_http_headers_filter_module.expires.notes: Static route expires_seconds generates a relative expiry. NGINX modifications and status rules differ.

ngx_http_not_modified_filter_module.notes: Static and cached GET and HEAD evaluate conditional requests using selected metadata.

ngx_http_range_header_filter_module.notes: Bounded single, suffix and multipart byte-range parsing with date If-Range.

ngx_http_range_body_filter_module.notes: Bounded single and multipart range streaming from validated descriptors.

ngx_http_try_files_module.try_files.notes: Shared literal candidates and =404 subset. Other statuses, scripts and cross-route fallback differ.

ngx_http_gzip_filter_module.notes: Route-local negotiated streaming gzip; Cauce also supports Brotli.

ngx_http_gzip_filter_module.gzip.notes: Opt-in streaming gzip with separately configured preference and safety policy.

ngx_http_gzip_filter_module.gzip_comp_le.notes: Configurable gzip level. Codec and buffering differ.

ngx_http_gzip_filter_module.gzip_types.notes: Exact or type wildcard MIME policy.

ngx_http_gzip_filter_module.gzip_min_len.notes: Minimum required size and configurable unknown-length handling.

ngx_http_gzip_static_module.notes: Opt-in precompressed sibling selection. Cauce also supports .br.

ngx_http_gzip_static_module.gzip_static.notes: Fresh .gz variants with negotiation and confined lookup. Always mode differs.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_cache.notes: Bounded shared memory cache for explicitly public origin representations.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_cache_key.notes: Fixed scheme, authority, effective URI and configured representation selectors.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_cache_lock.notes: Bounded client-deadline single flight with complete-body publication.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_cache_revali.notes: Conditional cache revalidation with restricted 304 metadata.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_cache_bypass.notes: Explicit bypass header and conservative request privacy policy.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_cache_use_st.notes: Configured stale-on-error and stale followers while a leader revalidates.

ngx_http_proxy_module.proxy_cache_valid.notes: Configurable cacheable status codes and a route freshness cap.

ngx_http_core_module.gzip_vary.notes: Vary: Accept-Encoding added on eligible representations.

behaviors.scope: An independent aioquic client validates HTTPS authority, QUIC Retry, TLS 1.3 and a shared 200 response body against NGINX 1.30.8.
Stream TCP half-close and weighted 3:1 distribution against NGINX 1.30.8.
Stream UDP echo datagram boundaries against NGINX 1.30.8.
Stream TLS visible SNI and default routing against NGINX 1.30.8.
Trusted Stream PROXY v1 source identity and body preservation against NGINX 1.30.8.
Recursive IPv4 and IPv6 forwarding, X-Real-IP, rejection of spoofed chains and final-route CIDR authorization.
Capture and query handling, local 308, named locations and internal hop exhaustion.
3:1 weighted distribution and stable address selection in shared socket cases; algorithms remain partially mapped.
Shared request limits, HTTP/2 concurrency and reload persistence, physical peer socket recovery.
Origin-form HTTP/1.1, request and response streaming, keepalive
ALPN and prior knowledge, stream quotas, cancellation and connection reuse. Known-empty upstream uploads end in initial HEADERS and zero-data uploads with trailers forward those trailers.
Absolute framing deadline for partial headers and continuation; bounded observer under an address-sanitized fuzz campaign
Native gRPC cleartext and TLS, deadlines, trailers and backpressure
HTTP/1.1 upgrade tunnel, bounded idle and lifetime, base RFC6455 framing passthrough
Exact and edge-wildcard authorities with exact path and segment-aware prefix routing
Top-level exact, literal prefix, ^~, and first matching ASCII byte regex precedence on validated shared paths.
Static request replacement and removal and response header replacement and removal, route isolation, protected headers and rejected reload.
Inbound exact SNI and default certificates, verified upstream connections, TLS versions and bounded session resumption

Global and endpoint budgets, HTTP/1 exclusive leases and HTTP/2 multiplexing. The experimental endpoint-sharded pool uses the same numeric endpoint and generation identity. The compact pool remains the default.
SIGHUP route/upstream and certificate reload with rejected candidate preservation
Passive backoff and optional HTTP/1, HTTP/2 and standard unary gRPC active probes as Cauce extensions
Fixed JSONL with bounded queue, rotation and drop counters
Disable JSONL output while preserving HTTP/1 request IDs, trace forwarding, pool reuse, rejection and response counters
Listener-wide downstream client authentication and upstream client certificates; optional authentication and per-SNI trust policies differ
Shared root, alias, index, literal try_files, GET, HEAD, conditional metadata and single, suffix, multipart and date If-Range responses. Filesystem policy and weak ETag representation differ.
Conservative bounded shared memory cache, conditional revalidation, stale windows and single-flight. Disk storage and complete NGINX proxy_cache semantics unavailable.
Negotiated streaming gzip and Brotli, static precompressed siblings and range bypass.
Client-IP allowlists on final routes.
Shared bounded zones with rate, burst, bounded delay and concurrency policies.
Bounded route actions with numbered captures and internal jumps. Nested and PCRE-only semantics remain open.
Decoded output and negotiated headers match pinned NGINX on the shared static gzip workload.
